# Jus Different

> Jus Different builds products, writes essays, and runs campaigns that turn attention into obsession.

Track record, per the homepage: over $100M managed in paid ads across Wiz, ClickUp, Redis, Zoom, Pinterest, and Own; grew Cuddy to $3M in annual revenue; Buyline has over 10K readers; 3M+ followers across all socials for content creators, music artists, and brands, including 300k+ on Instagram.
